hook: The vault opens above the clouds
caption_explanation_en: A vault in the sky opens and the cat grabs the impossible horizon before it slips away.
overview_ko: 구름 위 성채에서 금고가 열리며 아침빛이 목도리처럼 번지는 이야기다.
continuity_ko: 치즈탭비 고정 외형을 유지하고 흰 네 발과 흰 목·가슴·배, 흰 블레이즈를 반드시 강조한다.

creative_fingerprint.twist_ko: 아침 햇살이 실제로 목도리처럼 고양이 주변을 두름
camera_setups: 24mm sky-castle wide, towering storm wall background, brass vault glow and sun-scarf rim light

images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. dramatically annoyed face, one paw dramatically raised, in a medieval sky castle courtyard above clouds, an ancient vault opens to a bright impossible horizon, the cat stands beside a tiny paper-plane pilot prop on a stone parapet as if guarding a timeline archive, a towering storm wall looms behind while sunrise light is physically composited into a scarf-like ribbon around the chest, safe staged VFX, crisp castle stone, clouds below, 24mm lens, eye-level to slightly low viewpoint, strong separation, shallow depth of field, no text, no logos, no watermark, no extra limbs, no clothing, no shoes
